title: orobanche minor var. ambigua
intro: Orobanche minor var. ambigua, commonly known as the Lesser Broomrape, is a parasitic flowering plant that belongs to the broomrape family (Orobanchaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Orobanche minor var. ambigua include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, making it useful in treating wounds, skin infections, and fungal diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
